title: Che novità!
subtitle: The Count and the Countess: recitative from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 2
note: The Count finds the closet locked and grows suspicious
about: Score: the recitative “Che novità!” (Scena V) before No. 13 (vocal score pages 119-122, 28 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
